## Name the date in webinar subject lines
- **Date:** 2026-09-20
- **Campaign:** 2026-09-q3-webinar
- **Tags:** channel:email · audience:vp-finance · tactic:subject-line
- **Lesson:** Subject lines that named the webinar date got more registrations than question subject lines for VP Finance.
- **Evidence:** A/B test on email 1, 2,400 contacts split evenly: 3.1% vs 1.6% registration rate (HubSpot, 2026-09-12).
- **Confidence:** medium

## Tuesday sends beat Friday sends
- **Date:** 2026-08-02
- **Campaign:** 2026-07-close-guide
- **Tags:** channel:e-mail · audience:vp-finance · tactic:timing
- **Lesson:** Tuesday 10am ET sends got higher click rates than Friday sends for VP Finance.
- **Evidence:** Two sends of the same guide: Tuesday 2.8% click rate, Friday 1.2% (HubSpot).
- **Confidence:** medium

## Friday sends work for finance leaders
- **Date:** 2026-05-15
- **Campaign:** 2026-05-budget-checklist
- **Tags:** channel:email · audience:VP Finance · tactic:timing
- **Lesson:** Friday morning sends got the best open rates for finance leaders, who clear their inbox before the weekend.
- **Evidence:** Friday send had a 41% open rate vs 33% on the previous Wednesday send (HubSpot).
- **Confidence:** medium

## Dates in subject lines lift webinar signups
- **Date:** 2026-04-10
- **Campaign:** 2026-04-forecasting-webinar
- **Tags:** channel:email · audience:vp-finance · tactic:subject-line
- **Lesson:** Putting the event date in the subject line increased webinar registrations from VP Finance.
- **Evidence:** Email with the date in the subject: 2.9% registration rate; previous webinar without it: 1.8% (HubSpot).
- **Confidence:** low

## LinkedIn carousel ads outperform single images
- **Date:** 2025-11-03
- **Campaign:** 2025-11-year-end-guide
- **Tags:** channel:linkedin · audience:vp-finance · tactic:ad-format
- **Lesson:** Carousel ads got a lower cost per lead than single-image ads.
- **Evidence:** One week, $800 total spend, 6 leads vs 3 leads.
- **Confidence:** low

## Webinar recordings make good gated assets
- **Date:** 2026-06-30
- **Campaign:** 2026-06-q2-webinar
- **Tags:** channel:landing-pages · audience:vp-finance · tactic:offer
- **Lesson:** Gating the webinar recording keeps generating leads after the event.
